origine_fr: 丬 et la femme 女. La femme qui se pare : le maquillage, comme dans 化妆. 丬, reste de 牀 qui donnait le son, se lit qiáng, loin de zhuāng.
origine_en: 丬 and woman 女. A woman adorning herself: make-up, as in 化妆. 丬, all that is left of 牀, which gave the sound, is read qiáng, far from zhuāng.

phrase.pinyin: Tā měitiān zǎoshang dōu yào huàzhuāng.
phrase.fr: Elle se maquille tous les matins.
phrase.en: She puts on make-up every morning.
